pairing.title: Pair a device
pairing.help: Pair a phone app such as meshenger by scanning a QR code. The code works once and expires quickly.
pairing.ingressNotice: The device cannot pair through Home Assistant: it will reach Meshloom at the address in the QR code.
pairing.createHelp: Name the device, choose what it may do and how long the code stays valid. Meshloom then shows a QR code for the device to scan.
pairing.label: Device name
pairing.scopesHelp: Tick only what the device needs. The device never gets more than your role allows.
pairing.qrHelp: Scan this QR code with meshenger on the device. It will not be shown again.
pairing.secretWarning: This QR code works like a password: do not share it, and scan it only with your own device.
pairing.qrAlt: QR code to pair a device with Meshloom
pairing.expired: This code has expired and the QR code is hidden. Create a new one.
pairing.used: This code was used by the device: pairing is done. Create a new code to pair another device.
